svg.title: Native MFD debug-address calibration
svg.desc: Two native MPEG-2 observer sessions measured matching REV 50, TEST_PORT_CNTL 8, REV 50 triples twice at each of two stages. ADDR_SEL 1 names the SOFT_INPUT address-source enum; TP_ADDR is raw zero. Six complete native sessions delivered 1080 frames matching retained full captures. No pixel-source, view-identity, admission, ownership, freshness or standalone claim.

g.text: BCM70015 · two observed MPEG-2 sessions · progressive 640×360 · unscaled native YUY2
6 logical reads · same paired triples in A and repeat
6 logical reads · same paired triples in A and repeat
Raw numeric field; no certified view identity
Native pixels: 640×360 YUY2 · 6 sessions × 180 frames = 1080 complete host frames
5 MPEG-2 captures + final H.264 recovery: each 82,944,000 bytes, byte-exact against its retained reference.
All six: firmware EOS · pending 0 · ready 0 · cleanup PASS · fds 3→3 · threads 1→1 · stderr empty.
Bounded observer: 2 stages; at most 12 logical reads. Eight inherited native packing reads per session remain separate.
Equal sequential tuples do not prove atomicity, pixel source, admission, selector ownership, freshness or a source lease.
Measured source ed90a684 · no selector writes, TEST_PORT_DATA reads or pointer following · original issue #92 remains incomplete.
